say:1:1411427001:1.text: She's not here either... That kid's quicker than she looks.
say:1:1411427001:1.source_cn: 到了这里还不见人影……她跑得也太快了。

say:2:1411427002:1.text: Sorry, everyone. Can I leave the Hypogean to you? I don't have time to keep chasing her.
say:2:1411427002:1.source_cn: 抱歉，各位，追捕恶魔的事能交给你们吗？我可能没法继续追击了。

choice_prompt:3:1411427002.text: Sorry, everyone. Can I leave the Hypogean to you? I don't have time to keep chasing her.
choice_prompt:3:1411427002.source_cn: 抱歉，各位，追捕恶魔的事能交给你们吗？我可能没法继续追击了。

say:4:1411427003:1.text: Yeah, she caused more confusion than real harm, but the best thing I can do now is calm things down.
say:4:1411427003:1.source_cn: 是的，她造成的混乱比损失大，现在最重要的是先平息事态。
say:4:1411427003:1.male: Yeah, she caused more confusion than real harm, but the best thing I can do now is calm things down.
say:4:1411427003:1.female: Yeah, she caused more confusion than real harm, but the best thing I can do now is calm things down.

say:5:1411427005:1.text: I need to repair and set up the equipment, coordinate the miners' evacuation, and tend to the injured.
say:5:1411427005:1.source_cn: 我得留在这边先整备装备，组织起躲藏的矿工，救助伤员。

say:6:1411427006:1.text: And someone has to notify Sal'thorin. Indris and Ravion need to be looped in.
say:6:1411427006:1.source_cn: 而且还有一点，得去萨洛克兰通知因度厄和沙利叶他们。

say:7:1411427007:1.text: A Hypogean showing up and these accidents happening on their land... There's no way we can let that go unreported.
say:7:1411427007:1.source_cn: 在他们的地盘上出现了恶魔和这样的事故，总不能瞒着负责人。

choice_prompt:8:1411427007.text: A Hypogean showing up and these accidents happening on their land... There's no way we can let that go unreported.
choice_prompt:8:1411427007.source_cn: 在他们的地盘上出现了恶魔和这样的事故，总不能瞒着负责人。

say:9:1411427008:1.text:
I certainly hope so.
Baelran, I'm truly sorry. We'll have to put the contract on hold for now.
say:9:1411427008:1.source_cn: 但愿如此吧。\n除了这些，巴赫朗先生，我需要道歉，此前...

say:11:1411427009:1.text: Why? You said the damage wasn't serious and the injuries were minimal.
say:11:1411427009:1.source_cn: 哦？为什么呢，祖娅？你不是说，损失不大，伤员也不算多吗？

say:12:1411427010:1.text: Yes, the impact was limited, but we can't take any chances. We need time to stop work, reorganize, and double-check the safety of the area where the blasts occurred.
say:12:1411427010:1.source_cn: 但事情已经发生，我们还是需要花费些时间停工整顿，安全起...

say:13:1411427011:1.text: This delay will likely affect our ore and metal delivery. And we may not hit the original quota either.
say:13:1411427011:1.source_cn: 这段耽搁的时间下来，你需要的矿石恐怕无论是数量还是时间...

say:14:1411427012:1.text: I'm amenable to adjusting the terms. Let's start by extending the initial supply deadline by a month. If you need more time, I'm willing to allow up to three.
say:14:1411427012:1.source_cn: 如果只是这样，我愿意修改合约的期限。一个月够吗？不够的...

say:15:1411427013:1.text: Actually, two weeks would be enough. But how can we let you take that loss?
say:15:1411427013:1.source_cn: 半个月就足够了，但这怎么好意思……

say:16:1411427014:1.text: Well, I'm an investor. I believe in your potential and the future you're building here.
say:16:1411427014:1.source_cn: 毕竟我是个投资商，我看好的是你们的未来。

say:17:1411427015:1.text: As for whether a few days of delay will affect anything, I can afford to take the risk.
say:17:1411427015:1.source_cn: 至于这未来会不会延误几天，我想，这点风险我还承担得起。

say:18:1411427016:1.text: What's more, what happened here was caused by a Hypogean. That's clearly force majeure—beyond anyone's control.
say:18:1411427016:1.source_cn: 更何况，你们的遭遇是恶魔在搞鬼，对普通人来说，这是不可抗力。

say:19:1411427017:1.text: Looking back on what happened, I must say that the spirit and enthusiasm your miners displayed in the face of such a sudden accident have only strengthened my confidence.
say:19:1411427017:1.source_cn: 而且一路看过来，面对这种突发事故，你们矿工的精气神，对...

say:20:1411427018:1.text: But with the Hypogean still at large and causing problems, it's hard to say how long the suspension might last.
say:20:1411427018:1.source_cn: 但如果一直无法抓到恶魔，或者她还在捣乱，恐怕停工的时间...

say:21:1411427019:1.text: Zanie, your directness and strong sense of responsibility have only made me trust you even more.
say:21:1411427019:1.source_cn: 而祖娅，作为负责人，你坦诚的态度与坚定的责任心，更是让...

say:22:1411427020:1.text: I'm confident that this investment will be a great success, as your dedication and passion will undoubtedly lead to positive results.
say:22:1411427020:1.source_cn: 我相信，这份投资一定会非常成功，因为你们的努力和热情，...

say:23:1411427021:1.text: How about this? I'll extend the delivery period by three months. If you face any financial challenges, I'll be happy to offer you an interest-free loan tailored to your needs.
say:23:1411427021:1.source_cn: 这样吧，我将交货期限延长三个月，如果你们在经费上有什么...

say:24:1411427022:1.text: Thank you so much! You have my word that I'll have your order prepared as quickly as possible with no compromise on quality or quantity.
say:24:1411427022:1.source_cn: ……太感谢你了，巴赫朗！我在此保证，一定会尽快整备，保...

say:27:1411427023:0.text: After expressing her gratitude once more, Zanie swiftly gets to work organizing her team. Her loud voice can be heard ringing out from afar.
say:27:1411427023:0.source_cn: 祖娅多次表达了感谢后，急匆匆地去组织人手了，隔着老远都...
say:27:1411427023:0.male: After expressing her gratitude once more, Zanie swiftly gets to work organizing her team. Her loud voice can be heard ringing out from afar.
say:27:1411427023:0.female: After expressing her gratitude once more, Zanie swiftly gets to work organizing her team. Her loud voice can be heard ringing out from afar.

say:28:1411427024:1.text: Everyone, to uphold our contract and ensure Zanie's success, we must capture that Hypogean as quickly as possible.
say:28:1411427024:1.source_cn: 所以，诸位，看在我们的合约与祖娅的工作上，我们也得早些...

say:30:1411427004:1.text: There's no real damage, but she's still left a mess. I'll need to handle things here.
say:30:1411427004:1.source_cn: 虽然没什么损失，但她还是造成了很大的混乱，我得在这里处...
